ledger.x: Late September 1703: Rakoczi's rising holds most of Hungary east and north of the Danube.
September 1705: the Diet at Szecseny elects Rakoczi ruling prince (fejedelem) of the Confederated Estates, with a 24-member Senate; the rising becomes the Confederated Estates.
1 May 1711: the Confederated Estates end with the war.

wars.name: Rakoczi's War of Independence

certainty.note: The page gives no frontier, no seat and no area for the rising; the land is an administrative reading of 'east and north of the Danube' and the front moved with the campaigns.
